responsibility: Declares the item-resolution visitors used in the Rust frontend’s main AST name-resolution phase. It defines classes for resolving ordinary items, trait items, impl items, and extern items after top-level declaration collection, including the hooks that descend into nested scopes, resolve bodies and types, and coordinate with the separate top-level resolver and pattern/type/statement resolvers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the family of item-oriented resolver classes—ResolveItem, ResolveTraitItems, ResolveImplItems, and ResolveExternItem—and their entry points for post-collection item resolution. Unlike the matching .cc file, it is the class/interface definition layer and not the implementation of item traversal, use handling, or selftests.
